sentences.zh: 夏殷已上，左史記言，右史記事，周則太史、小史、內史、外史、御史，分掌其事，而諸侯之國，亦置史官。

translations.literal: From the Xia and Yin dynasties upward, the left scribe recorded speech and the right scribe recorded events. Under Zhou the Grand Scribe, Junior Scribe, Internal Scribe, External Scribe, and Imperial Censor divided these duties among themselves, and the states of the feudal lords likewise appointed historiographers.
translations.idiomatic: From the Xia and Yin dynasties upward, the left scribe recorded speech and the right scribe recorded events. Under Zhou the Grand Scribe, Junior Scribe, Internal Scribe, External Scribe, and Imperial Censor divided these duties among themselves, and the states of the feudal lords likewise appointed historiographers.

sentences.zh: 又《春秋國語》引周志、鄭書之說，推尋事蹟，似當時記事，各有職司，後又合而撰之，總成書記。

translations.literal: Moreover, the Discourses of the States and the Spring and Autumn cite the chronicles of Zhou and the documents of Zheng; tracing the events, it seems that record-keeping at the time was assigned to separate offices, and that these were later combined and compiled into comprehensive historical writings.
translations.idiomatic: The Discourses of the States and the Spring and Autumn cite the chronicles of Zhou and the documents of Zheng; tracing the events, it seems that record-keeping at the time was assigned to separate offices, and that these were later combined and compiled into comprehensive historical writings.

sentences.zh: 其後陵夷衰亂，史官放絕，秦滅先王之典，遺制莫存。

translations.literal: Afterward the realm declined into disorder and the historiographers were abolished; Qin destroyed the institutions of the former kings, and no trace of the old system remained.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the realm declined into disorder and the historiographers were abolished; Qin destroyed the institutions of the former kings, and no trace of the old system remained.

sentences.zh: 至漢武帝時，始置太史公，命司馬談為之，以掌其職。

translations.literal: It was not until the reign of Emperor Wu of Han that the office of Grand Historian was first established and Sima Tan was appointed to it to oversee its duties.
translations.idiomatic: It was not until the reign of Emperor Wu of Han that the office of Grand Historian was first established and Sima Tan was appointed to it to oversee its duties.

sentences.zh: 時天下計書，皆先上太史，副上丞相，遺文古事，靡不畢臻。

translations.literal: At that time all provincial reports from throughout the realm were first sent to the Grand Historian and a copy to the Chancellor; surviving texts and ancient events—none failed to reach them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time all provincial reports from throughout the realm were first sent to the Grand Historian and a copy to the Chancellor; surviving texts and ancient events—none failed to reach them.

sentences.zh: 談乃據《左氏》、《國語》、《世本》、《戰國策》、《楚漢春秋》，接其後事，成一家之言。

translations.literal: Tan then drew upon the Mr. Zuo, the Discourses of the States, the Genealogical Records, the Intrigues of the Warring States, and the Annals of Chu and Han, continuing the narrative from where they left off to form a school of history in his own right.
translations.idiomatic: Tan then drew upon the Mr. Zuo, the Discourses of the States, the Genealogical Records, the Intrigues of the Warring States, and the Annals of Chu and Han, continuing the narrative from where they left off to form a school of history in his own right.

sentences.zh: 談卒，其子遷又為太史令，嗣成其志。

translations.literal: When Tan died, his son Qian also became Grand Historian and carried on his father's design.
translations.idiomatic: When Tan died, his son Qian also became Grand Historian and carried on his father's design.

sentences.zh: 上自黃帝，訖於炎漢，合十二本紀、十表、八書、三十世家、七十列傳，謂之《史記》。

translations.literal: Beginning with the Yellow Emperor and ending with the Han dynasty, it comprised twelve basic annals, ten tables, eight treatises, thirty hereditary houses, and seventy arrayed biographies—this work was called the Records of the Grand Historian.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning with the Yellow Emperor and ending with the Han dynasty, it comprised twelve basic annals, ten tables, eight treatises, thirty hereditary houses, and seventy arrayed biographies—this work was called the Records of the Grand Historian.

sentences.zh: 遷卒以後，好事者亦頗著述，然多鄙淺，不足相繼。

translations.literal: After Qian's death, enthusiasts also wrote histories in considerable number, but most were shallow and unworthy to succeed him.
translations.idiomatic: After Qian's death, enthusiasts also wrote histories in considerable number, but most were shallow and unworthy to succeed him.

sentences.zh: 至後漢扶風班彪，綴後傳數十篇，並譏正前失。

translations.literal: In Later Han, Ban Biao of Fufeng appended several dozen chapters of continuation and also criticized errors in the earlier work.
translations.idiomatic: In Later Han, Ban Biao of Fufeng appended several dozen chapters of continuation and also criticized errors in the earlier work.

sentences.zh: 彪卒，明帝命其子固續成其志。

translations.literal: When Biao died, Emperor Ming ordered his son Gu to continue and complete his father's intent.
translations.idiomatic: When Biao died, Emperor Ming ordered his son Gu to continue and complete his father's intent.

sentences.zh: 以為唐、虞、三代，世有典籍，史遷所記，乃以漢氏繼于百王之末，非其義也。

translations.literal: He held that the eras of Tang, Yu, and the Three Dynasties each had their own canonical records, whereas what Sima Qian recorded placed the Han dynasty after the hundred kings—this was not the proper principle.
translations.idiomatic: He held that the eras of Tang, Yu, and the Three Dynasties each had their own canonical records, whereas what Sima Qian recorded placed the Han dynasty after the hundred kings—this was not the proper principle.

sentences.zh: 故斷自高祖，終於孝平、王莽之誅，為十二紀、八表、十志、六十九傳。

translations.literal: Therefore he began with Emperor Gaozu and ended with the execution of Emperor Ping and Wang Mang, producing twelve annals, eight tables, ten treatises, and sixty-nine biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore he began with Emperor Gaozu and ended with the execution of Emperor Ping and Wang Mang, producing twelve annals, eight tables, ten treatises, and sixty-nine biographies.

translations.literal: He devoted himself to the work with concentrated thought for more than twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: He devoted himself to the work with concentrated thought for more than twenty years.

sentences.zh: 建初中，始奏表及紀傳，其十志竟不能就。

translations.literal: In the early Jianchu era he first submitted his memorial together with the annals and biographies, but the ten treatises were never completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Jianchu era he first submitted his memorial together with the annals and biographies, but the ten treatises were never completed.

sentences.zh: 固卒後，始命曹大家續成之。

translations.literal: After Gu's death, the court at last ordered Madame Cao to continue and complete the work.
translations.idiomatic: After Gu's death, the court at last ordered Madame Cao to continue and complete the work.

sentences.zh: 先是明帝召固為蘭台令史，與諸先輩陳宗、尹敏、孟冀等，共成《光武本紀》。

translations.literal: Earlier, Emperor Ming had summoned Gu to serve as Clerk of the Orchid Terrace; together with senior scholars Chen Zong, Yin Min, Meng Ji, and others, they completed the Basic Annals of Emperor Guangwu.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Emperor Ming had summoned Gu to serve as Clerk of the Orchid Terrace; together with senior scholars Chen Zong, Yin Min, Meng Ji, and others, they completed the Basic Annals of Emperor Guangwu.

translations.literal: Gu was promoted to Gentleman and put in charge of collating the secret archives.
translations.idiomatic: Gu was promoted to Gentleman and put in charge of collating the secret archives.

sentences.zh: 固撰後漢事，作《列傳載記》二十八篇。

translations.literal: Gu compiled events of Later Han and produced twenty-eight chapters of Biographical Records and Annals.
translations.idiomatic: Gu compiled events of Later Han and produced twenty-eight chapters of Biographical Records and Annals.

sentences.zh: 其後劉珍、劉毅、劉陶、伏無忌等，相次著述東觀，謂之《漢記》。

translations.literal: Thereafter Liu Zhen, Liu Yi, Liu Tao, Fu Wuji, and others wrote in succession at the Eastern Pavilion; their work was called the Records of Han.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Liu Zhen, Liu Yi, Liu Tao, Fu Wuji, and others wrote in succession at the Eastern Pavilion; their work was called the Records of Han.

sentences.zh: 及三國鼎峙，魏氏及吳，並有史官。

translations.literal: When the Three Kingdoms stood in tripartite rivalry, Wei as well as Wu each had historiographers.
translations.idiomatic: When the Three Kingdoms stood in tripartite rivalry, Wei as well as Wu each had historiographers.

sentences.zh: 晉時，巴西陳壽刪集三國之事，唯魏帝為紀，其功臣及吳、蜀之主，並皆為傳，仍各依其國，部類相從，謂之《三國志》。

translations.literal: In Jin times, Chen Shou of Ba commandery edited and compiled the affairs of the Three Kingdoms: only the Wei emperor received annals, while meritorious ministers and the rulers of Wu and Shu were all given biographies; still arranged by state and category, the work was called the Records of the Three Kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: In Jin times, Chen Shou of Ba commandery edited and compiled the affairs of the Three Kingdoms: only the Wei emperor received annals, while meritorious ministers and the rulers of Wu and Shu were all given biographies; still arranged by state and category, the work was called the Records of the Three Kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 壽卒後，梁州大中正範穎表奏其事，帝詔河南尹、洛陽令，就壽家寫之。

translations.literal: Shouthe cited text, Provincial Rectifier of Liang Provincethe cited text, the cited textNanthe cited text,Magistrate of Luoyang, the cited textShouthe cited text..
translations.idiomatic: After Shou died, Fan Ying, Grand Rectifier of Liang Province, submitted a memorial reporting the matter; the emperor ordered the governor of Henan and the magistrate of Luoyang to go to Shou's home and copy it.

sentences.zh: 自是世有著述，皆擬班、馬，以為正史，作者尤廣。

translations.literal: From this time onward there were authors of historical works everywhere, all taking Ban Gu and Sima Qian as models and treating their works as standard histories; authors became especially numerous.
translations.idiomatic: From this time onward there were authors of historical works everywhere, all taking Ban Gu and Sima Qian as models and treating their works as standard histories; authors became especially numerous.

translations.literal: Histories of a single dynasty numbered as many as several dozen schools.
translations.idiomatic: Histories of a single dynasty numbered as many as several dozen schools.

sentences.zh: 唯《史記》、《漢書》，師法相傳，並有解釋。

translations.literal: Only the Records of the Grand Historian and the Book of Han were handed down from master to pupil, and both had explanatory commentaries.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Records of the Grand Historian and the Book of Han were handed down from master to pupil, and both had explanatory commentaries.

sentences.zh: 《三國志》及范曄《後漢》，雖有音注，既近世之作，並讀之可知。

translations.literal: The Records of the Three Kingdoms and Fan Ye's Book of Later Han, though they have pronunciation guides and commentaries, are recent works and can be understood upon reading.
translations.idiomatic: The Records of the Three Kingdoms and Fan Ye's Book of Later Han, though they have pronunciation guides and commentaries, are recent works and can be understood upon reading.

sentences.zh: 梁時，明《漢書》有劉顯、韋棱，陳時有姚察，隋代有包愷、蕭該，並為名家。

translations.literal: In Liang times those who mastered the Book of Han included Liu Xian and Wei Leng; in Chen times there was Yao Cha; in Sui times there were Bao Kai and Xiao Gai—all were renowned masters.
translations.idiomatic: In Liang times those who mastered the Book of Han included Liu Xian and Wei Leng; in Chen times there was Yao Cha; in Sui times there were Bao Kai and Xiao Gai—all were renowned masters.

translations.literal: Transmitters of the Records of the Grand Historian were very few.
translations.idiomatic: Transmitters of the Records of the Grand Historian were very few.

sentences.zh: 今依其世代，聚而編之，以備正史。

translations.literal: Now, arranged by period, they are gathered and compiled to supplement the standard histories.
translations.idiomatic: Now, arranged by period, they are gathered and compiled to supplement the standard histories.

translations.literal: Since the historiographers were abolished, successive authors all took Ban Gu and Sima Qian as their standard.
translations.idiomatic: Since the historiographers were abolished, successive authors all took Ban Gu and Sima Qian as their standard.

sentences.zh: 起漢獻帝，雅好典籍，以班固《漢書》文繁難省，命潁川荀悅作《春秋左傳》之體，為《漢紀》三十篇。

translations.literal: Beginning with Emperor Xian of Han, who greatly loved the classics, finding Ban Gu's Book of Han too verbose and hard to abridge, he ordered Xun Yue of Yingchuan to compose in the style of the Zuo Tradition of the Spring and Autumn, producing the Annals of Han in thirty chapters.

sentences.zh: 言約而事詳，辯論多美，大行於世。

sentences.zh: 至晉太康元年，汲郡人發魏襄王塚，得古竹簡書，字皆科斗。

translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Taikang era of Jin, a man of Ji commandery excavated the tomb of King Xiang of Wei and obtained ancient bamboo-slip books written in tadpole script.

sentences.zh: 發塚者不以為意，往往散亂。

translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Xun Xu, Director of the Secretariat, and He Qiao, Director of the Masters of Writing, to arrange them into fifteen sections in eighty-seven scrolls.

sentences.zh: 多雜碎怪妄，不可訓知，唯《周易》、《紀年》，最為分了。

translations.literal: Much was miscellaneous, fragmentary, strange, and absurd, and could not be reliably understood; only the Book of Changes and the Chronological Annals were most clearly distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Much was miscellaneous, fragmentary, strange, and absurd, and could not be reliably understood; only the Book of Changes and the Chronological Annals were most clearly distinguished.

sentences.zh: 其《周易》上下篇，與今正同。

translations.literal: Its upper and lower sections of the Book of Changes are exactly the same as the present text.
translations.idiomatic: Its upper and lower sections of the Book of Changes are exactly the same as the present text.

sentences.zh: 《紀年》皆用夏正建寅之月為歲首，起自夏、殷、周三代王事，無諸侯國別。

translations.literal: The Chronological Annals all use the first month of the Xia calendar, establishing yin as the year's beginning; they begin with the royal affairs of the Xia, Yin, and Zhou Three Dynasties, without distinction among feudal states.
translations.idiomatic: The Chronological Annals all use the first month of the Xia calendar, establishing yin as the year's beginning; they begin with the royal affairs of the Xia, Yin, and Zhou Three Dynasties, without distinction among feudal states.

sentences.zh: 唯特記晉國，起自稱殤叔，次文侯、昭侯，以至曲沃莊伯，盡晉國滅。

translations.idiomatic: They specially record the state of Jin, beginning with the one called Shang Shu, then Marquis Wen, Marquis Zhao, down to Zhuang Bo of Quwo, ending with the destruction of Jin.

sentences.zh: 獨記魏事，下至魏哀王，謂之「今王」。

translations.literal: They record Wei affairs alone, down to King Ai of Wei, whom they call "the present king."
translations.idiomatic: They record Wei affairs alone, down to King Ai of Wei, whom they call "the present king."

sentences.zh: 古之史官，必廣其所記，非獨人君之舉。

translations.literal: The historians of antiquity necessarily made broad records, not only of the ruler's actions.
translations.idiomatic: The historians of antiquity necessarily made broad records, not only of the ruler's actions.

sentences.zh: 《周官》：外史掌四方之志，則諸侯史記，兼而有之。

translations.literal: Offices of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Offices of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 《春秋傳》曰：「虢仲、虢叔，王季之穆，勳在王室，藏於盟府。」

translations.literal: Spring and Autumn Tradition.
translations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn Tradition.

sentences.zh: 臧紇之叛，季孫命太史召掌惡臣而盟之。

translations.literal: When Zang He rebelled, Jisun ordered the Grand Historian to summon the officer in charge of evil ministers and bind him by covenant.
translations.idiomatic: When Zang He rebelled, Jisun ordered the Grand Historian to summon the officer in charge of evil ministers and bind him by covenant.

sentences.zh: 《周官》：司寇凡大盟約，蒞其盟書，登於天府。

translations.literal: Offices of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Offices of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 太史、內史、司會，六官皆受其貳而藏之。

translations.literal: The Grand Historian, Interior Scribe, and Director of Accounts, and all six offices, received duplicates and stored them.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Historian, Interior Scribe, and Director of Accounts, and all six offices, received duplicates and stored them.

sentences.zh: 是則王者誅賞，具錄其事，昭告神明，百官史臣，皆藏其書。

translations.literal: Thus, when the king punished or rewarded, the matter was fully recorded and announced to the spirits; the hundred officials and historical ministers all stored the writings.
translations.idiomatic: Thus, when the king punished or rewarded, the matter was fully recorded and announced to the spirits; the hundred officials and historical ministers all stored the writings.

sentences.zh: 故自公卿諸侯，至於群士，善惡之跡，畢集史職。

translations.literal: Therefore, from high ministers and feudal lords down to the various officers, traces of good and evil all gathered in the historians' offices.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, from high ministers and feudal lords down to the various officers, traces of good and evil all gathered in the historians' offices.

sentences.zh: 而又閭胥之政，凡聚眾庶，書其敬敏任恤者，族師每月書其孝悌睦涘有學者，党正歲書其德行道藝者，而入之于鄉大夫。

translations.literal: And in the administration of the village overseer, whenever the common people were assembled, he recorded those who were reverent, diligent, responsible, and compassionate; the clan instructor each month recorded those who were filial, fraternal, harmonious, peaceful, and learned; the district chief annually recorded those who had virtue, conduct, ways, and arts, and submitted them to the district grand officer.
translations.idiomatic: And in the administration of the village overseer, whenever the common people were assembled, he recorded those who were reverent, diligent, responsible, and compassionate; the clan instructor each month recorded those who were filial, fraternal, harmonious, peaceful, and learned; the district chief annually recorded those who had virtue, conduct, ways, and arts, and submitted them to the district grand officer.

sentences.zh: 鄉大夫三年大比，考其德行道藝，舉其賢者能者，而獻其書。

translations.literal: Every three years, at the great comparison, the district grand officer examined their virtue, conduct, ways, and arts, recommended the worthy and capable, and presented the records.
translations.idiomatic: Every three years, at the great comparison, the district grand officer examined their virtue, conduct, ways, and arts, recommended the worthy and capable, and presented the records.

sentences.zh: 王再拜受之，登於天府，內史貳之。

translations.literal: The king bowed twice and received them, placed them in the Heavenly Repository, and the Interior Scribe made a duplicate.
translations.idiomatic: The king bowed twice and received them, placed them in the Heavenly Repository, and the Interior Scribe made a duplicate.

sentences.zh: 是以窮居側陋之士，言行必達，皆有史傳。

translations.literal: For this reason, even men dwelling in poverty and obscurity necessarily had their words and conduct made known, and all had historical biographies.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason, even men dwelling in poverty and obscurity necessarily had their words and conduct made known, and all had historical biographies.

sentences.zh: 自史官曠絕，其道廢壞，漢初，始有丹書之約，白馬之盟。

translations.literal: After the historians' offices fell vacant and severed, their Way decayed; at the beginning of Han there first were the covenant written in red and the covenant of the white horse.
translations.idiomatic: After the historians' offices fell vacant and severed, their Way decayed; at the beginning of Han there first were the covenant written in red and the covenant of the white horse.

sentences.zh: 武帝從董仲舒之言，始舉賢良文學。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu followed Dong Zhongshu's advice and first recommended the worthy and good and literary scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu followed Dong Zhongshu's advice and first recommended the worthy and good and literary scholars.

sentences.zh: 天下計書，先上太史，善惡之事，靡不畢集。

translations.literal: The accounting documents from all under Heaven were first submitted to the Grand Historian, and matters good and evil were all completely gathered.
translations.idiomatic: The accounting documents from all under Heaven were first submitted to the Grand Historian, and matters good and evil were all completely gathered.

sentences.zh: 司馬遷、班固，撰而成之，股肱輔弼之臣，扶義俶儻之士，皆有記錄。

translations.literal: Sima Qian and Ban Gu compiled them into completed works, so ministers who served as arms and legs and aides, and men who upheld righteousness with outstanding bearing, all had records.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Qian and Ban Gu compiled them into completed works, so ministers who served as arms and legs and aides, and men who upheld righteousness with outstanding bearing, all had records.

sentences.zh: 昔者先王之化民也，以五方土地，風氣所生，剛柔輕重，飲食衣服，各有其性，不可遷變。

translations.literal: In ancient times, when the former kings transformed the people, the lands of the five regions, what their winds and qi produced, their hardness and softness, lightness and heaviness, food and clothing, each had its own nature and could not be shifted or changed.
translations.idiomatic: In ancient times, when the former kings transformed the people, the lands of the five regions, what their winds and qi produced, their hardness and softness, lightness and heaviness, food and clothing, each had its own nature and could not be shifted or changed.

sentences.zh: 是故疆理天下，物其土宜，知其利害，達其志而通其欲，齊其政而修其教。

translations.literal: Therefore they delimited and ordered all under Heaven, assessed what the lands were suited for, understood their advantages and harms, reached their intentions and communicated their desires, unified their governance and cultivated their teaching.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore they delimited and ordered all under Heaven, assessed what the lands were suited for, understood their advantages and harms, reached their intentions and communicated their desires, unified their governance and cultivated their teaching.

sentences.zh: 故曰廣穀大川異制，人居其間異俗。

translations.literal: Thus it says: "Broad valleys and great rivers have different systems; people dwelling among them have different customs."
translations.idiomatic: Thus it says: "Broad valleys and great rivers have different systems; people dwelling among them have different customs."

sentences.zh: 《書》錄禹別九州，定其山川，分其圻界，條其物產，辨其貢賦，斯之謂也。

sentences.zh: 周則夏官司險，掌建九州之圖，周知山林川澤之阻，達其道路。

translations.literal: Under Zhou, the Summer-office Director of Frontiers was charged with establishing maps of the Nine Provinces, knowing thoroughly the obstacles of mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes, and communicating their roads.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhou, the Summer-office Director of Frontiers was charged with establishing maps of the Nine Provinces, knowing thoroughly the obstacles of mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes, and communicating their roads.

sentences.zh: 地官誦訓，掌方志以詔觀事，以知地俗。

translations.literal: The Reciter of Instructions in the offices of the earth was in charge of regional records, using them to announce matters to be observed and to know local customs.
translations.idiomatic: The Reciter of Instructions in the offices of the earth was in charge of regional records, using them to announce matters to be observed and to know local customs.

sentences.zh: 春官保章，以星土辨九州之地，所封之域，以觀祅祥。

translations.literal: The Guardian of Patterns in the spring offices used stars and terrestrial divisions to distinguish the lands of the Nine Provinces and the regions enfeoffed, in order to observe baleful and auspicious signs.
translations.idiomatic: The Guardian of Patterns in the spring offices used stars and terrestrial divisions to distinguish the lands of the Nine Provinces and the regions enfeoffed, in order to observe baleful and auspicious signs.

sentences.zh: 夏官職方，掌天下之圖地，辨四夷八蠻九貉五戎六狄之人，與其財用九穀六畜之數，周知利害，辨九州之國，使同其貫。

translations.literal: The Director of Regions in the summer offices was in charge of maps and lands under Heaven; distinguished the peoples of the four Yi, eight Man, nine Mo, five Rong, and six Di, together with their resources and the numbers of the nine grains and six domestic animals; fully knew advantages and harms; distinguished the states of the Nine Provinces; and caused them to share a common order.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Regions in the summer offices was in charge of maps and lands under Heaven; distinguished the peoples of the four Yi, eight Man, nine Mo, five Rong, and six Di, together with their resources and the numbers of the nine grains and six domestic animals; fully knew advantages and harms; distinguished the states of the Nine Provinces; and caused them to share a common order.

sentences.zh: 司徒掌邦之土地之圖與其人民之教，以佐王擾邦國，周知九州之域，廣輪之數，辨其山林川澤丘陵墳衍原隰之名物，及土會之法。

translations.literal: The Minister of Education was in charge of maps of the state's lands and of teaching its people, to assist the king in pacifying states and domains; he fully knew the extent of the Nine Provinces and the measures of breadth and length, distinguished the names and products of mountains, forests, rivers, marshes, hills, mounds, plains, and wetlands, and knew the laws for land accounting.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Education was in charge of maps of the state's lands and of teaching its people, to assist the king in pacifying states and domains; he fully knew the extent of the Nine Provinces and the measures of breadth and length, distinguished the names and products of mountains, forests, rivers, marshes, hills, mounds, plains, and wetlands, and knew the laws for land accounting.

sentences.zh: 然則其事分在眾職，而塚宰掌建邦之六典，實總其事。

translations.literal: Thus these affairs were divided among many offices, while the Chief Minister, who established the six canons of the state, in fact oversaw them.
translations.idiomatic: Thus these affairs were divided among many offices, while the Chief Minister, who established the six canons of the state, in fact oversaw them.

sentences.zh: 太史以典逆塚宰之治，其書蓋亦總為史官之職。

translations.literal: The Grand Historian used the canons to check the Chief Minister's governance; those records were probably also collectively the responsibility of the historians' office.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Historian used the canons to check the Chief Minister's governance; those records were probably also collectively the responsibility of the historians' office.

sentences.zh: 漢初，蕭何得秦圖書，故知天下要害。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Han, Xiao He obtained Qin maps and documents, and therefore knew the strategic places under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Han, Xiao He obtained Qin maps and documents, and therefore knew the strategic places under Heaven.

translations.literal: In Emperor Wu's time, after the accounting documents had been submitted to the Grand Historian, the geographical treatises of commanderies and kingdoms were also certainly included among them.
translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Wu's time, after the accounting documents had been submitted to the Grand Historian, the geographical treatises of commanderies and kingdoms were also certainly included among them.

translations.literal: But what Sima Qian recorded only described rivers and canals.
translations.idiomatic: But what Sima Qian recorded only described rivers and canals.

translations.literal: In Han times, Liu Xiang's Separate Records and Liu Xin's Seven Summaries analyzed categories and currents, each with its section; tracing the events, this is likely the ancient system.
translations.idiomatic: The In Han times, Liu Xiang's Separate Records and Liu Xin's Seven Summaries analyzed categories and currents, each with its section; tracing the events, this is likely the ancient system.

sentences.zh: 自是之後，不能辨其流別，但記書名而已。

sentences.zh: 博覽之士，疾其渾漫，故王儉作《七志》，阮孝緒作《七錄》，並皆別行。

sentences.zh: 是故前言往行，無不識也；

translations.literal: Within they oversee the eight handles to instruct the king's governance; without they wield the six canons to assist official administration.
translations.idiomatic: The Within they oversee the eight handles to instruct the king's governance; and without they wield the six canons to assist official administration.

sentences.zh: 書美以彰善，記惡以垂戒，範圍神化，昭明令德，窮聖人之至賾，詳一代之亹亹。

translations.literal: They write of beauty to manifest goodness and record evil to hand down warning; they encompass divine transformation, illuminate splendid virtue, exhaust the utmost profundity of sages, and detail the tireless effort of an age.
translations.idiomatic: The They write of beauty to manifest goodness and record evil to hand down warning; and they encompass divine transformation, illuminate splendid virtue, exhaust the utmost profundity of sages, and detail the tireless effort of an age.

sentences.zh: 自史官廢絕久矣，漢氏頗循其舊，班、馬因之。

translations.literal: Since the historiographers were abolished long ago, the Han dynasty largely followed the old ways, and Ban Gu and Sima Qian continued them.
translations.idiomatic: The Since the historiographers were abolished long ago, the Han dynasty largely followed the old ways, and Ban Gu and Sima Qian continued them.

translations.literal: Since Wei and Jin, the practice has declined ever further.

translations.literal: The posts of Nan and Dong were filled by those enriched by salary and leisure; the offices of Zheng and Jun were rarely granted on the basis of talent.
translations.idiomatic: The posts of Nan and Dong were filled by those enriched by salary and leisure; and the offices of Zheng and Jun were rarely granted on the basis of talent.

sentences.zh: 故梁世諺曰：「上車不落則著作，體中何如則秘書。」

translations.literal: Hence a proverb of the Liang era said: "If you don't fall off the carriage, you become an Author; if you feel unwell, you become a Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: The Hence a proverb of the Liang era said: "If you don't fall off the carriage, you become an Author; and if you feel unwell, you become a Secretary.

sentences.zh: 於是屍素之儔，盱衡延閣之上，立言之士，揮翰蓬茨之下。

translations.literal: Thus idle parasites strutted above the Extended Pavilion, while men who set forth words wielded their brushes beneath thatched roofs.
translations.idiomatic: The Thus idle parasites strutted above the Extended Pavilion, while men who set forth words wielded their brushes beneath thatched roofs.

sentences.zh: 班固以《史記》附《春秋》，今開其事類，凡十三種，別為史部。

translations.literal: Ban Gu classified the Records of the Grand Historian under the Spring and Autumn; now expanding its categories, there are thirteen types in all, separately forming the History section.
translations.idiomatic: The Ban Gu classified the Records of the Grand Historian under the Spring and Autumn; now expanding its categories, there are thirteen types in all, separately forming the History section.
